QuestInfo.name: Distorted Signal
QuestInfo.0: The sandstorm is too strong for Ferret to get a good read on the crystal's signal.
QuestInfo.1: You'll have to defeat around #b50#k #b#o2400357##k monsters to clear up the storm. It's the only way Ferret will be able to get a clearer signal.
QuestInfo.2: You cleared some of the interference, so Ferret could pinpoint the signal. Hurry over to the next location while he's still got a good read on it.

default.0: The storm is a lot worse than before, and it's scattered the signal. You've got to defeat about #b50#k #b#o2400357##k monsters near here before you'll be able to pick it up again.
